蓝碳项目在碳市场中面临哪些“额外性”与“泄漏”难题？

What additionality and leakage challenges do blue-carbon projects face in carbon markets?

需证明保护是额外于“照常”基线、且碳被真正长期封存的；同时保护一处湿地可能把开发压力转移到别处（泄漏）。监测、报告、核查（MRV）成本高也限制规模。
They must show protection is additional to business-as-usual and carbon is truly locked long-term; protecting one wetland may shift development elsewhere (leakage). High MRV cost also limits scale.

红树林为什么能“存住”碳？

Why can mangroves 'store' carbon?

红树的根把落叶和泥土稳稳抱住，烂掉也不易被冲走，碳就悄悄埋在泥里很多年。
Mangrove roots hold leaves and mud firmly; even as they rot, they aren't washed away, so carbon is quietly buried in the mud for many years.

什么是“蓝碳”（blue carbon）？

What is blue carbon?

指海岸与海洋生态系统（红树林、盐沼、海草床）通过光合作用固定的碳，并长期埋藏在沉积物中。它们单位面积固碳效率常高于陆地森林。
It is carbon fixed by coastal and marine ecosystems (mangroves, salt marshes, seagrass beds) via photosynthesis and stored long-term in sediments. Their per-area sequestration is often higher than terrestrial forests.
